capabilities: Render vault notes and frequent words as an interactive 3D nebula with a physics engine
Highlight words that co-occur in the same note when hovering a core word
Jump from a floating word to the original note via a context snippet popup
Filter notes by time ranges such as the last 7 days or 30 days
Adjust the sidebar height and auto-recover after sidebar switches
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a separate note-taking interface; it is a sidebar visualization and navigation layer over existing notes.
extras: The README is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese). It warns that mobile and desktop use different architectures and that mobile users should install the separate 'Thought Synapse (Mobile)' version instead. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Bugs should be reported via GitHub Issues or Xiaohongshu with device model and Obsidian version.
motivation: The author wanted to visualize the flow of knowledge in a personal knowledge base as a tangible, breathing 3D nebula rather than a static word cloud.
problem: Obsidian's default graph view and word analysis lack an interactive 3D visualization that links words to the notes where they co-occur.
summary: 3D semantic network and word cloud that renders vault notes and high-frequency words as an interactive, physics-driven sidebar constellation.
